focus: The GPU broker landed this week — a FastAPI proxy that serializes P100 access across KoboldCPP, ComfyUI, and ollama, with SillyTavern confirmed working end-to-end from a separate LAN machine. Also wired a model-name rewrite so ST doesn't show 'inactive' in the model list when kobold has idle-unloaded. On the phillipsben side, the daily dashboard refresh is stable and running each morning.
